policy.verification: Every schedule row should include an official source URL. If not confirmed from an official source, leave value blank and flag as unverified.
policy.estimation: Future seasons without officially released per-game schedules are marked ESTIMATED. Estimated windows are based on official league season-structure sources and historical patterns; they are not official game schedules.
policy.no_hallucination: No game times, opponents, or broadcast details are invented. Unconfirmed fields are blank/null and flagged.
